scope: End-to-End Orchestrator v2.2 Controlled Pilot Validation

businessContext.systemGoal: Real-time temperature excursion monitoring, IoT dry-ice shipment telemetry, and regulatory 21 CFR Part 11 chain-of-custody compliance for mRNA vaccines and biological specimens.

primaryUserRoles.environment: Dual-monitor ops desk under fluorescent lighting
primaryUserRoles.primaryWorkflow: Fleet-wide excursion triage, courier rerouting, temperature alert verification

primaryUserRoles.environment: Mobile in transit, direct sunlight, sterile dock receiving
primaryUserRoles.primaryWorkflow: QR shipment handoff, dry-ice seal inspection, sensor check-in

mandatoryDataFields: Target Temp Zone (-80°C Ultra-Low, -20°C Frozen, +4°C Chilled)

stage1_Discovery.rule: Zero redundant questions asked; requirements mapped into REQUIREMENTS_MAP.md

stage2_CodebaseAnalysis.rule: Check domain enums, status workflows, and token architectures

stage3_VisualResearch.rule: Extract minimum 2 distinct palette candidates and 2 verified font pairings

stage4_CreativeDirection.rule: Formulate 2 structurally divergent concepts across all 10 mandatory dimensions
stage4_CreativeDirection.gate: 🛑 CONCEPT APPROVAL GATE: Mandatory user review and explicit sign-off in chat. Auto-approval prohibited.

stage5_NativeDesignSystem.recipes: All 7 native execution recipes (3-tier tokens, icon vectors, master atoms, variant sets, linked instances, auto-layout, composite pattern)
stage5_NativeDesignSystem.stressTesting: 8-Point Component Stress Testing Protocol (All 8 tests must achieve PASS with zero false claims)

stage6_DesignSystemApprovalGate.gate: 🛑 DESIGN SYSTEM APPROVAL GATE: Mandatory user review of unselected component sheet screenshot. Auto-approval prohibited.

stage7_ApplicationScreens.componentIntegrity: 100% of interactive and repeated controls must be INSTANCE nodes. Layout containers must be FRAME with Auto Layout.
stage7_ApplicationScreens.lockedColumns: |delta_x| <= 1.0px across table header and all data rows
stage7_ApplicationScreens.zeroDataLoss: Text wrapping as default; truncation only permitted on secondary hashes/paths

stage8_AutomatedQA.unselectedScreenshot: Export unselected canvas screenshot to exports/

stage9_VisualReview.humanSignOff: Subjective craft and aesthetic hierarchy evaluated via Tier 2 Multimodal Review. Deterministic PASS does not bypass Human Sign-Off.
